new.title: Ask a problem
new.description: Describe what is blocking you. While you type, we check whether someone already solved it.
new.titleHint: One precise sentence: the tech, the symptom, the error message.
new.bodyHint: Context, what you tried, the exact error. Markdown supported.
new.reproHint: A tiny HTML / CSS / JS example that reproduces the bug. Others can run it and fix it.
new.errTitle: The title must be 8 to 160 characters long.
new.similarIdle: Write your title: close problems will show up here.
new.similarNone: Nothing close yet. Your problem looks new.
new.similarCallout: A solved problem looks a lot like yours. Have a look before publishing.
new.triageIdle: Suggests topics, a level, a summary and leads. Nothing is applied without you.
new.triageKeep: Attach the summary and leads to my problem

repro.consoleEmpty: Run the repro to see its output.
repro.sandboxNote: Runs in a sandbox isolated from your account.

detail.notFound: This problem does not exist (any more).
detail.acceptedToast: Problem solved. Thanks for closing the loop.
detail.answerPlaceholder: Explain the cause, then the fix. Markdown supported.
detail.aiDraftNote: Automatically generated draft. Review and correct it before publishing.
detail.forkNote: Fix the repro: it will be attached to your answer.
detail.author: Asked by
